page.layout: One page of text in one column. Running head at top centre. Left margin holds one note beside the start of the paragraph "HETRVSCAM", set in small type.

main_text.p: Abinu, fchæbafchamáin. jithkaddéfch fchemæcha. tábo malcuta chá. jehafsæh re-tzonechá cebafchamáim ubaárætz. æth lach ménu temidi ténlánu hajóm. ufelách lánu æth chobothénu,caafchær anáchnu folechin lebahalé chobothénu. veáltebénu benífsajón ællá hatzillénu meiáh ci lechá hammalcúth, ugeburáh vecábed leholám holemím. Amen.
main_text.head: Reddita & verbis Latinis:
main_text.p: Pater noster, qui es in cœlis: sanctificetur nomen tuum: Veniat regnum tuum: Fiat voluntas tua sicut in cœlis, & in terra: Panem nostrum continuum vel perpetuum da nobis hodie: & remitte nobis debita nostra, quemadmodum nos remittimus debitoribus nostris: & ne facias nos venire in tentationem, sed libera nos à malo. Quia tuum regnum, & potentia, & gloria, in secula seculorum. Amen.

Hetrusca lingua hodie nulla: olim à Latina diffe-rens.HETRVSCAM linguam hodie nullam esse puto: olim à Latina plurimum differebat, ut ex vocabulis quibusdam paucis, apud Auctores, apparet: quale est Aesar, id est, deus, in Augusto Suetonii. Padus à profunditate Botigon ab Hetruscis nuncupatur, à Liguribus Botigum. Ancona, priùs

page.notes: The Hebrew prayer is printed in Latin letters (transliteration), so it is copied as printed. The first word of the Lord's Prayer in the Latin section is "Pater". The word "Aesar" appears as "Aefar" in the scan, where the long s is plain s by rule; the reading is doubtful and marked here, not in the text. The left margin note line breaks are shown with hyphens as printed ("ho-", "La-", "diffe-"). A stray mark in the left margin is not printed text and is omitted. No page number is printed on this page.
